description: Return structured Git.Top knowledge for a project or collection, including the compact agent summary, overview, alternatives, deployments, quality score, agent score, project_kind, and collection_metadata when applicable. Prefer search_projects first when the canonical owner/repo id is uncertain.

inputSchema.description: Provide project_id, repo, or both owner and repo. The runtime validates that one supported project reference is present.

owner.description: GitHub owner; use with repo when project_id is omitted.

project.description: Alias for project_id; accepts a canonical owner/repo identifier or Git.Top product alias.

project_id.description: Canonical owner/repo identifier or a Git.Top product alias such as claude-code or cursor. The repo field may also contain owner/repo.

repo.description: GitHub repository name, or owner/repo when owner is omitted.

require_d1.description: Fail closed unless the tool result is backed by D1 instead of seed fallback.

name: get_project
